'''Pallaris Ven''' was a [[Resistance pilot]] who flew as [[Blue Four]] in [[Blue Squadron (Resistance)|Blue Squadron]] during the [[Battle of Starkiller Base]]. During the battle, Ven and their [[astromech droid]] [[BR-BA]] were [[Death|killed]].<ref name="Poe Dameron 28" />
